description: Type the 429 a create, resume or fork gets when the account has used every sandbox start its plan includes in the last hour: {"code": "rate_limited", "message": "You used all 60 sandbox starts included in the last hour.\nYour running sandboxes keep running. New ones can start again at 17:23 UTC.…"}. Observed live 2026-11-07 on POST /sandboxes. It matches only the hourly quota ("in the last hour"); the per-minute limit stays the generic, retried TooManyRequests. It is retryable as throttling, so it declares `retryAfter` and the retry waits at least the server's hint: Boat sends Retry-After on every 429, "the time the limit frees, or the length of its window when that time is not known" (components.headers.RetryAfter, spec-mirror-boat-dev 99ea417).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The account used every sandbox start its plan includes in the last hour (resumes and forks count). Retried after the server's Retry-After; `retryAfter` says when starts are available again. Extra starts can be enabled in Boat's billing settings.

message.includes: sandbox starts included in the last hour
